messages.subject: Re: Temporary delivery hold
messages.body:
The hold caught the addresses we expected. One concern: quarantine checks the address as submitted. The resolver cleans it up later.

I asked about swapping the order. Integration wants another compatibility pass before we touch the queue. I've left a comment in the meantime.

messages.subject: Re: Temporary delivery hold
messages.body: Please open a ticket. If this comes back to us on a weekend, the person on call won't know where to look for the comment.
